scope: GLOBAL-REASSIGN-ORACLE-V1 local-CPU T0/T1 control-result count diagnostics

trigger.failure_stage: T0 result construction after all 36 official per-video fragments and frozen aggregate/delta computation

diagnosis.mismatch: the harness treated the frozen run-level official_summary return object as though it retained the official per-sample metric-row schema

t0_fragment_schema_evidence.conclusion: T0 fragments are official per-sample metric rows and are correctly aggregated through frozen official_summary

frozen_summary_schema_evidence.input_behavior: requires edge_tp/edge_fp/edge_fn on every valid per-sample row and consumes them to compute the micro-averaged edge_jaccard
frozen_summary_schema_evidence.return_behavior: returns edge_jaccard and division counts but deliberately does not return aggregate edge_tp, edge_fp, or edge_fn
frozen_summary_schema_evidence.incorrect_harness_lookup: run_control indexed official_candidate['edge_tp'] and official_baseline['edge_tp'] only while constructing report count diagnostics

control_path.required_runtime_behavior: the resumed sealed guard must still emit INVALID_HARNESS if either control misses its frozen expected delta by more than 1e-9

repair.behavior: For non-scoring report counts only, sum edge TP/FP/FN from the already-scored per-video baseline_metric and candidate_metric fragment rows. Continue to compute all preregistered aggregates and deltas exclusively with frozen official_summary.
repair.validation: Require every fragment count to be finite, nonnegative, and integer-valued; cross-check summed division TP/FP/FN against the frozen summary return values.

baseline_edges_determination.actual_meaning: sum over 36 videos of unique directed source-target edge pairs present in each baseline APNCC SubmissionGraph before frozen scorer filtering
baseline_edges_determination.baseline_true_edges_meaning: baseline graph edges whose matched endpoints reproduce a GT edge
baseline_edges_determination.why_edge_jaccard_is_not_1181938_denomina: the frozen scorer evaluates only temporally valid prediction edges touching annotated GT topology after node matching, merge deduplication, and out-degree filtering; the remaining graph edges are outside the sparse-GT edge estimand

preserved_t3.fragment_aggregate_definition: SHA-256 over sorted fragment filename, NUL, and binary per-file SHA-256 digest

preserved_t0_fragments.fragment_aggregate_definition: SHA-256 over sorted fragment filename, NUL, and binary per-file SHA-256 digest

resume_precondition.reason: the sealed guard refuses to overwrite its reserved guard receipt path and the completed T3 artifacts must resume byte-identically
